integrity: Exact integer proof independent of finite tests; the tests are reproducibility checks, not certification or evidence for infinite quantifiers. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim treats all fixed integers p>=2 with a>p, but only consecutive generators a and a+1. The original 2026 paper already provides full branch formulas and makes the prime-modulus least-period case implicit; the new structural conclusion concerns uniform sharpness, especially composite p. No independent priority assessment, no general b or varying-p least-period result.
title: The exact least quasipolynomial period for consecutive-generator Frobenius quotients
